# testing_x_terraform_ignore (Resource)

XTerraformIgnore Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_terraform_ignore" "my_xterraformignore" {
  configurable                     = "...my_configurable..."
  secondary_operation_configurable = "...my_secondary_operation_configurable..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `configurable` (String) Configurable (non-ignored)
- `secondary_operation_configurable` (String) Secondary operation configurable (non-ignored)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Describes the state of the entity.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_terraform_ignore.my_testing_x_terraform_ignore
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_terraform_ignore.my_testing_x_terraform_ignore "..."
```
